inputs_outputs_semantics: Each list is the vocabulary across the module operations, not a requirement to provide every type at once. Before activation each operation requires an exact closed payload schema and cardinality signature in FunctionDefinition/implementation registry. This high-level catalog is not an executable routing schema.
